scenario: Update store profile with all valid data
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps:
1. Change Store Name, Description and Contact Number to the test data.
2. Upload the logo and the banner.
3. Click Save.
4. Refresh the Store Settings page.
5. Log in as Buyer 1 in another browser and open Seller 1's store page.
6. Search for 'Maria Clara Handicrafts PH' as Buyer 1.
data:
Store Name: Maria Clara Handicrafts PH
Description: Handwoven bags and home decor from Bulacan artisans.
Contact Number: 09189876543
Logo: store_logo.png (300 KB)
Banner: store_banner.jpg (1.8 MB)
expected: A success message is shown. After refresh every field shows the saved value. The buyer's store page shows the new name, description, logo and banner, and the store search finds the new name. The old name no longer appears anywhere on the buyer side. No other store's data changes.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps:
1. Clear Store Name and click Save.
2. Refresh, clear Contact Number and click Save.
3. Refresh, clear Pickup Address (each part) and click Save.
4. Refresh the page after each attempt.
data: Clear in turn: Store Name, Contact Number, Region, City / Municipality, Barangay, Street Address
expected: Each attempt is blocked. A required-field message appears on the blank field only. After refresh, the original values are still saved; nothing was changed.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps:
1. Enter only spaces in Store Name.
2. Click Save.
expected: Saving is blocked with the required-field message (spaces are trimmed, so the field counts as empty). The old store name is kept.

scenario: Store name already used by another store
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps:
1. Enter each store name in the test data, one per attempt.
2. Click Save each time.
data:
RV Gadget Hub
rv gadget hub
'  RV Gadget Hub  ' (with leading and trailing spaces)
expected: All three are blocked with a message that the store name is already taken (the check ignores case and leading or trailing spaces). Seller 1's name is unchanged.

scenario: Store name length at the limits
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps:
1. Enter each store name in the test data, one per attempt.
2. Click Save each time and note the result.
data:
2 characters: MC (reject)
3 characters: MCH (accept)
30 characters: Maria Clara Handicrafts Bulaca (accept)
31 characters: Maria Clara Handicrafts Bulacan (reject)
expected: 2 and 31 characters are rejected with a message stating the 3–30 character limit. 3 and 30 characters are saved exactly as typed. The field does not silently cut off the 31st character.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps:
1. Paste a 500-character description and save.
2. Paste a 501-character description and save.
expected: 500 characters are saved and shown in full on the store page. 501 characters are rejected with a limit message, or the field stops input at 500; the saved text is never cut silently after saving.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps: 1. Enter each contact number, one per attempt, and save.
data:
09189876543 (accept)
+639189876543 (accept)
0918987654 (10 digits, reject)
091898765432 (12 digits, reject)
0918-ABC-6543 (reject)
08189876543 (does not start with 09, reject)

scenario: Logo and banner file type and size
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
steps:
1. Upload each file as the logo, one at a time, and save.
2. Repeat every file as the banner.
3. Refresh after each attempt.
data:
size_4.9MB.jpg (accept)
size_5.0MB.jpg (accept)
size_5.1MB.jpg (reject)
price_list.docx (reject)
installer.exe (reject)
renamed_exe.jpg (reject)
expected: The 4.9 MB and 5.0 MB images are accepted. The 5.1 MB file, the DOCX, the EXE and the renamed EXE are rejected with a message naming the allowed types and the 5 MB limit. After a rejection the previous logo or banner is still shown.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Vacation mode is on. Buyer 1 has P-02 in the cart.
steps:
1. Turn off vacation mode and save.
2. As Buyer 1, refresh P-02.
3. Check out the cart item by COD.
expected: The 'On vacation' label is gone, Add to Cart and Buy Now are enabled, and the order is placed normally.

scenario: Seller that is not Approved tries to publish

2. Click Publish.

scenario: Script and HTML in text fields
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.

1. Enter the test data in Description.
2. Save and open the store page as Buyer 1.
3. Open the browser console.
expected: The text is shown literally or with the tags removed. No pop-up appears, no image error triggers a script, and the console shows no script execution.

scenario: Seller cannot edit another store's settings
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved).
steps:
1. Open Store Settings and note the store ID in the URL or request.
2. Change it to Seller 2's store ID and reload or resend the save request.
expected: Access is denied (403, not found, or redirect). No Seller 2 data is shown and nothing about Seller 2's store changes.

1. Create a category named Bags.

expected: Seller 2's Bags is created. Seller 1's categories are unchanged (store categories are unique per store only).

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). CAT-1 Bags contains P-01.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). CAT-1 is hidden.
steps:
1. Show CAT-1.
2. Open the store page as Buyer 1.
expected: Bags appears again in its previous position with P-01 in it.

scenario: Delete a category that still has products
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). CAT-4 Baskets contains P-02 only.
steps:

2. Read the warning and click Cancel. Check that CAT-4 still exists.

scenario: Delete a parent category with subcategories
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). CAT-2 Home Decor has subcategories Lamps (P-03) and Baskets (P-02).
steps: 1. Delete CAT-2 and confirm.
expected: The warning lists both subcategories and the 2 products affected. After confirming, Home Decor, Lamps and Baskets are all gone, and P-02 and P-03 are in Uncategorized, still Active. No product is deleted.

scenario: Subcategory nesting at the depth limit
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). CAT-2 Home Decor > CAT-3 Lamps exists.
steps:
1. Create Wall Decor under Home Decor (level 2).
2. Try to create Table Lamps under Lamps (level 3).

Level 2: Wall Decor (accept)
Level 3: Table Lamps (reject)

scenario: Product in several store categories at the limit
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved).
steps:

2. Try to add a 4th category, New Arrivals.

expected: 3 categories are accepted and P-03 shows exactly once in each. The 4th is blocked with a limit message.

scenario: Store category is separate from platform category
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved).
steps:
1. Edit P-01: change the store category to Kitchen & Dining; leave the platform category as Women's Bags.
2. As Buyer 1, browse the platform category Women's Bags.
3. Open Seller 1's store page, Kitchen & Dining.
expected: P-01 still appears under the platform category Women's Bags and now under the store's Kitchen & Dining. Changing the store category did not change the platform category, and sellers cannot create or rename platform categories.

scenario: Add and publish a product with all valid data
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Add Product page is open.
steps:

expected: Each attempt is blocked and a required-field message is shown on that field only. The other entered values (including uploaded images) are kept on the form. No product is created.

steps:

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Add Product page is open.
steps:
1. Enter each stock value, one per attempt.

scenario: Publish a draft with missing data

expected: Publishing is blocked with required-field messages. The product stays Draft.

scenario: Delete a product with unfinished orders
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). P-02 is in an order with status To Ship.
steps: 1. Click Delete on P-02 and confirm.
expected: Deletion is blocked with a message that the product has unfinished orders. P-02 stays Active.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Add Product page is open.

expected: Exactly one product is created.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved).
steps:

2. Replace the product ID in the URL with P-05's ID (Seller 2) and load it.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Buri Coin Purse has Color and Size.
steps: 1. Try to add a third variation type.

scenario: Options per type at the limit

steps:
1. Add 20 options to Color.

steps:
1. Give Red-S and Blue-S the same SKU.
2. Then use an SKU already used by P-01.
3. Publish each time.
expected: Both are blocked with a duplicate-SKU message.

scenario: Price range shown on the product page and search
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). P-01 is published.

expected: Search card and product page show ₱199 – ₱299. After selecting Natural-M the page shows ₱249.00 only.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved).
steps:
1. Set image A for Natural and image B for Black.

expected: The main image changes to the selected colour's image each time.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). P-01 Black-M stock is 0.
steps:
1. As Buyer 1, open P-01 and select Black.

expected: M is visible but disabled for Black and cannot be selected. Natural-M remains selectable. The page shows no error.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). A Completed order exists for P-01 Natural-M at ₱249.
steps:
1. Rename option Natural to Beige.

3. Add option Brown.

expected: The old order still shows Natural-M at ₱249.00 for both roles. The product page shows Beige and Brown with the new price.

scenario: Remove a variant that is in a buyer's cart
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Buyer 1 has P-01 Black-L in the cart.
steps:

scenario: Remove a variant with unfinished orders
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). P-01 Natural-S is in a To Ship order.

1. Delete the Natural-S row and save.

scenario: Stock deducted when a COD order is placed

steps:
1. As Buyer 1, order 2 × P-02 by COD.

expected: Stock is exactly 18 immediately after the order is placed.

scenario: Stock deducted when an unpaid e-wallet order is placed
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). P-02 stock is 20.
steps:
1. As Buyer 1, place an e-wallet order for 1 × P-02 but do not pay.

expected: Stock is 19 while the order is To Pay.

scenario: Stock restored when the buyer cancels
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). A COD order for 2 × P-02 exists; stock is 18.
steps:
1. As Buyer 1, cancel the order.
2. Check P-02's stock.
expected: Stock returns to exactly 20.

scenario: Stock restored on auto-cancel of an unpaid order
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). An unpaid e-wallet order for 1 × P-02 exists; stock is 19.

steps:
1. As Buyer 1, order 1 × Natural-M.
2. Check every P-01 variant's stock.
expected: Natural-M is 7. Every other variant is unchanged.

scenario: Overselling: 1 left, 2 buyers check out at once
preconditions: P-03 stock is 1. Buyer 1 and Buyer 2 each have P-03 in the cart on separate devices, both on the checkout page.

1. As Buyer 1, buy the last unit.
2. As Buyer 2, open P-07 and search for it.

expected: Buyer 2 sees 'Sold out' with Add to Cart and Buy Now disabled. Seller 2's list shows Out of Stock.

steps:
1. Sell 1 unit (stock 6) and check alerts.
2. Sell 1 more (stock 5) and check alerts.
3. Sell 1 more (stock 4) and check alerts.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved).
steps: 1. Set P-02 stock to each value, one per attempt, and save.
expected: Only 0 and 99,999 are saved. Each invalid value shows a message and the previous stock is kept.

scenario: Reduce stock below the quantity in a cart
preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Buyer 1 has 5 × P-02 in the cart.
steps:
1. Set P-02 stock to 3.

expected: The cart shows 'Only 3 left' and blocks checkout until the quantity is 3 or fewer. No order for 5 units can be placed.

steps:

scenario: Sale ends at the exact end time
preconditions: The sale is Ongoing. Buyer 1 has P-02 in the cart.
steps:
1. Open P-02 one minute before the end time.
2. Refresh one minute after the end time.
3. Refresh the cart and checkout.
expected: After the end time the price is ₱450.00 everywhere: product page, search card, cart and checkout. The badge and struck-through price are gone.

preconditions: Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved).
steps: 1. Try to save a sale with each date combination.
data:
End before start (reject)
Start = end (reject)
Start in the past (reject)

1. Click Cancel, choose 'Changed my mind', confirm.
2. Check stock and Seller 1's notifications.
expected: The order is Cancelled on both sides. Stock is 20. Seller 1 is notified with the reason.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps: 1. Click Cancel and confirm without a reason.
expected: Blocked until a reason is chosen. The order is unchanged.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. A paid e-wallet order with MCH50 is To Ship.
steps: 1. Cancel with a reason.
expected: The order is Cancelled and a refund for the exact amount paid is started. MCH50 returns to the wallet.

scenario: No cancel after Ready for Pickup
preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. Seller marked Ready for Pickup.
steps:
1. Look for Cancel.
2. Try the cancel request directly if possible.
expected: No Cancel option; a direct request is rejected and the status is unchanged.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. Rider picked up the parcel.
steps: 1. Look for Cancel.
expected: No Cancel option.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps: 1. Double-click Confirm Cancel.
expected: One cancellation; stock restored once (not twice).

scenario: Request a return within the window
preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. A P-02 order was Delivered 2 days ago.
steps:
1. Click Return/Refund.
2. Choose the item, reason, description and upload 2 photos.
3. Submit.
data:
Reason: Damaged item
Description: Basket arrived with a broken rim.
Photos: review_photo.jpg, product_front.jpg
expected: The request is submitted. The order moves to Return/Refund. Seller 1 is notified. The order can no longer be completed automatically while the request is open.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. An order is To Ship.
steps: 1. Look for Return/Refund.
expected: Not available.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps:
1. Request on day 7 after Delivered.
2. Try on another order 7 days + 1 hour after Delivered (now Completed).
expected: Allowed on day 7. Not available after the window or once Completed.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps:
1. Submit with 0 photos.
2. Submit with 6 photos.
3. Submit a 5.1 MB photo.
4. Submit a 9-character description.
expected: Each is blocked with a message. 1 to 5 valid photos and 10+ characters are required.

preconditions: A request exists.
steps:
1. Seller 1 rejects with a reason.
2. Open the request.
expected: Status Rejected with the seller's exact reason and an Escalate button.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. An order with P-02 is Completed.
steps:
1. Click Rate.
2. Choose 5 stars, add text and a photo.
3. Submit.
4. Open P-02's reviews as Buyer 2.
data:
Text: Matibay at maganda!
Photo: review_photo.jpg
expected: The review appears on P-02 with 5 stars, the text, the photo, the variant and Buyer 1's (masked) name.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. The order is To Receive.
steps:
1. Look for Rate.
2. Try the request directly.
expected: Not available; a direct request is rejected.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. P-02 already reviewed in this order.
steps: 1. Try to rate it again.
expected: Blocked; only Edit is offered.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps:
1. Submit with 0 stars.
2. Submit 500 characters of text, then 501.
3. Attach 5 photos, then try a 6th.
expected: 0 stars is blocked. 500 characters and 5 photos are accepted; 501 characters and a 6th photo are not.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps:
1. Edit the review once.
2. Try to edit again.
3. On another review older than 30 days, try to edit.
expected: The first edit saves. A second edit and an edit after 30 days are not possible.

preconditions: P-02 has one 4-star review.
steps: 1. Buyer 2 adds a 2-star review.
expected: Average becomes 3.0 and the count 2 on the product page and search card.

scenario: Chat with a seller from a product
preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps:
1. On P-02 click Chat.
2. Send a message and an image.
data:
Hi, available pa po ba?
review_photo.jpg
expected: Seller 1 receives both in order. The chat shows the P-02 product card.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps:
1. Attach installer.exe and size_5.1MB.jpg.
2. Send 1,001 characters.
expected: All are rejected; nothing is sent.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1.
steps: 1. Move an order through Accepted, Picked Up, Out for Delivery and Delivered.
expected: Exactly one notification per change. Each opens the right order.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. Set a reminder for P-02's flash sale.
steps: 1. Wait for the slot to start.
expected: A reminder arrives before the slot starts and links to P-02.

preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. 3 unread notifications.
steps:
1. Open one notification.
2. Click Mark all as read.
expected: Unread count goes 3 → 2 → 0.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Shipments exist in Pending (Ready for Pickup/Unassigned), In Transit, Delivered and Failed.
steps:
1. Open the dashboard and note each count.
2. Open the shipment list filtered by each status and count the rows.
expected: Each dashboard count equals the filtered list exactly.

scenario: Counts update after a status change
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Note In Transit and Delivered.
2. Rider 1 marks a parcel Delivered.
3. Refresh the dashboard.
expected: In Transit −1 and Delivered +1; other counts unchanged.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Filter today and a range that starts and ends on a shipment's date.
expected: Shipments on the start and end dates are counted.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Logistics 2 has shipments.
steps: 1. Compare the dashboard with Logistics 2's shipment count.
expected: No Logistics 2 shipment is counted or listed.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. A rider (rider.test02@example.com) is pending verification.
steps:
1. Open the record and both documents.
2. Click Approve.
3. Log in as that rider and go Online.
expected: Status Active; the rider can go Online. The approval is in the audit log.

scenario: Reject a rider with a reason
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Click Reject with an empty reason.
2. Reject with the test reason.
data: Reason: OR/CR photo is unreadable, please re-upload.
expected: The empty reason is blocked. After rejection the rider is notified with the exact reason and cannot go Online.

scenario: Suspend a rider with active jobs
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Rider 2 is Online with 1 Assigned (not picked up) job and 1 Picked Up job.
steps:
1. Suspend Rider 2 with a reason.
2. Check Rider 2's app, the Unassigned queue and the audit log.
data: Reason: Repeated late deliveries this week.
expected: Rider 2 goes Offline and cannot go Online. The Assigned job moves to the Unassigned queue; the Picked Up job stays with Rider 2. The suspension is logged.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Click Suspend with an empty or 9-character reason.
expected: Blocked; rider unchanged.

preconditions: Rider 3 is Suspended.
steps:
1. Reactivate Rider 3.
2. Log in as Rider 3 and go Online.
expected: Rider 3 is Active and can go Online.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Open the rider list.
expected: Each rider shows Online/Offline, active jobs (0–3) and today's completed deliveries, matching their apps.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 2.
steps:
1. Open Rider 1's record by URL or request.
2. Send a suspend request for Rider 1.
expected: Both are denied. Rider 1 is unchanged.

scenario: Auto-assign to the nearest eligible rider
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Rider 1 (near Seller 1) and Rider 2 (farther) are Online with 0 jobs. A parcel is Ready for Pickup.
steps: 1. Run auto-assign.
expected: The offer goes to Rider 1 first.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Assign the parcel to Rider 2 manually.
expected: Rider 2 receives it; status Assigned; the buyer timeline shows the assignment.

scenario: Offline or suspended rider not assignable
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Rider 1 is Offline; Rider 3 is Suspended.
steps:
1. Open Manual Assign.
2. Send an assign request for Rider 3 directly.
expected: Neither rider is listed. The direct request is rejected.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Rider 2 has 3 active jobs.
steps: 1. Try to assign a 4th.
expected: Blocked with a limit message.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Parcel Assigned to Rider 1.
steps: 1. Reassign to Rider 2.
expected: Rider 1 loses the job immediately; Rider 2 has it. The timeline shows both events.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Parcel Picked Up by Rider 1.
steps:
1. Look for Reassign.
2. Send the request directly.
expected: Not available; the request is rejected.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. 5 parcels are Ready for Pickup; Rider 2 has 0 jobs.
steps: 1. Select all 5 and assign to Rider 2.
expected: 3 are assigned and 2 are reported as skipped because of the 3-job limit. The 2 stay Unassigned.

scenario: Assign a parcel that is not ready
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. An order is only Packed.
steps:
1. Look for it in the dispatch queue.
2. Send an assign request directly.
expected: It is not in the queue and the request is rejected.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Rider 1 brings a Picked Up parcel to the hub.
steps:
1. Scan it at Inbound.
2. Check Buyer 1's timeline.
expected: Status At Hub with the scan time, in Logistics and Buyer views.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Sort the parcel.
expected: The parcel is placed in the NCR zone list only.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Scan at Outbound and assign Rider 1.
2. Rider 1 marks Out for Delivery.
expected: Status Out for Delivery; the delivery OTP appears in Buyer 1's order.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Scan the same parcel twice at Inbound.
expected: The second scan warns 'already received'. Only one At Hub event exists.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Scan an unknown tracking number.
expected: Rejected with 'not found'. No record is created.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Scan a parcel at Outbound before Inbound.
expected: Blocked; status unchanged.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Scan a Logistics 2 tracking number.
expected: Rejected; Logistics 2's shipment unchanged.

scenario: Search by tracking number, order ID or buyer
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Search by each value.
2. Search an unknown value and an injection string.
data: Tracking number; order ID; Juan Miguel Dela Cruz; ' OR '1'='1
expected: Each valid search returns exactly the right shipment. Unknown values return no results with no error.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. A parcel is Out for Delivery.
steps:
1. Override to Delivered with an empty reason.
2. Override with the test reason.
data: Reason: Rider app offline, delivery confirmed by phone.
expected: The empty reason is blocked. With the reason, status becomes Delivered.

preconditions: The previous case was run.
steps:
1. Open the audit log.
2. Look for Edit or Delete on the entry.
expected: The entry shows user, date and time, Out for Delivery → Delivered and the reason. There is no Edit or Delete.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Mark a parcel Lost with a reason.
expected: Status Lost; Buyer 1 and Seller 1 are notified; the refund or claim process starts.

scenario: Mark a parcel Damaged with a photo
preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Mark Damaged without a photo, then with one.
expected: Blocked without a photo; with it, status and photo are saved and both parties notified.

preconditions: A parcel failed 3 times.
steps: 1. Open the RTS queue.
expected: The parcel is listed with status Return to Sender and all 3 failure reasons.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Assign the RTS parcel to Rider 1.
2. Rider 1 delivers it to Seller 1.
3. Check all three views.
expected: Status Returned to Sender. Buyer: order Cancelled (failed delivery). Seller: Returned, awaiting confirmation.

scenario: Stock restored only when the seller confirms
preconditions: The RTS parcel (1 × P-02) is Returned to Sender; stock is 19.
steps:
1. Check stock.
2. Seller 1 confirms receipt.
3. Check stock again.
expected: Stock stays 19 until confirmation, then becomes 20.

scenario: Prepaid RTS refund and no earnings
preconditions: The RTS order was prepaid.
steps:
1. Complete RTS.
2. Check Buyer 1's refund and Seller 1's earnings.
expected: Buyer 1's refund for the full amount is started. Seller 1 has no earnings for the order.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1. Buyer 1 has an order placed at the old rate.
steps:
1. Change Within NCR first kg from ₱50 to ₱55.
2. As Buyer 1, start a new checkout of P-02 to ADDR-1.
3. Open the earlier order.
expected: The new checkout shows ₱55.00. The earlier order still shows ₱50.00. The change is in the audit log.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Enter each value and save.
expected: Only 0.01 saves.

preconditions: ADDR-4 is outside every zone.
steps: 1. As Buyer 1, check out to ADDR-4.
expected: Place Order is blocked with a not-serviceable message.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Add a zone covering Batanes with a rate.
2. As Buyer 1, check out to ADDR-4 again.
expected: Checkout now works and uses the new rate.

preconditions: Rider 1 collected ₱1,800.00 and remitted ₱1,800.00.
steps: 1. Open reconciliation for today.
expected: Collected ₱1,800.00, remitted ₱1,800.00, difference ₱0.00, with both orders listed.

preconditions: Rider 1 remitted ₱1,750.00.
steps: 1. Open reconciliation.
expected: Difference −₱50.00 is highlighted as a shortfall.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Confirm the remittance.
2. Check Rider 1's balance and the audit log.
expected: Rider 1's balance updates; the confirmation is logged.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps:
1. Export deliveries and COD for a date range as CSV and as XLSX.
2. Open both files.
expected: Both files download and open. Rows and totals equal the screen for the same filter.

preconditions: Logged in as Logistics 1.
steps: 1. Export a range with no records.
expected: A file with headers only, or a 'no data' message. No error.
